## Overview

Crafting digital experiences from idea to scale. I ship AI-first products on the modern web — TypeScript, Next.js and LLMs end to end — and I'm looking for a remote Full Stack or AI Engineer role.

## Selected work

[![Ora Mail](assets/ora-mail.png)](https://useora.co)

**[Ora Mail](https://useora.co)** — AI email client for Gmail, Outlook and IMAP. Auto-sorts the inbox, drafts replies in your writing style, and summarizes long threads.

[![IndieWrapped](assets/indiewrapped.png)](https://indiewrapped.com)

**[IndieWrapped](https://indiewrapped.com)** — Year in review for indie hackers. Visualize your progress and celebrate your wins with AI-powered insights.

[![FastDomain](assets/fastdomain.png)](https://fastdomain.io)

**[FastDomain](https://fastdomain.io)** — Real-time domain price comparison across registrars, plus an AI domain name generator.

Also built: Launch Express · Adapt2Move Mobility · Smart Parcel Box · Homematic Dashboard · Occupancy Planner — [more on bynico.dev](https://bynico.dev).
